verdict.rationale: New Relic ships its own programmatic surfaces. NerdGraph is a GraphQL API for querying data and configuring features, and NRQL is the same query language that powers the built-in charts and dashboards. The CLI and Terraform add more automation paths. However, the vendor's own docs say NerdGraph configures only "some" features, which contradicts full UI parity, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity across all features, a published API spec, and independent confirmation that UI workflows such as dashboard building and sharing work through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: NerdGraph is our GraphQL-format API that lets you query New Relic data and configure some New Relic features.
The same query language that powers New Relic's built-in charts and dashboards is available to you, so you can build the views and alerts your team needs.
You can use the New Relic CLI to manage entity tags, define workloads, record deployment markers, and much more.
